name: Kadai Chicken
subtitle: chicken with peppers in a coarse pounded coriander and chilli masala
prepNotes: Kadai masala is pounded coarse from whole coriander and dried chilli. Ready-ground powder gives a different, flatter dish.
Semi-dry is correct. If it is swimming, cook it down.

steps.text: Dry-roast the coriander seed and dried chillies until fragrant, cool, and pound coarse.
Sear the capsicum and onion petals on high for 2 minutes so they blister but stay firm. Lift out.
Brown the chicken in the same pan, then add the ginger paste and garlic.
Add the tomato and two-thirds of the pounded masala, cover, and cook 20 minutes until the chicken is done and the oil separates.
Return the peppers and onion, add the rest of the masala, and toss on high for 3 minutes.
steps.tip: High heat at the end drives off the last of the liquid.

steps.text: Finish with kasuri methi, garam masala, ginger julienne and coriander.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. The peppers soften overnight, which is a loss but not a disaster. Reheat hard and fast.
